# Non-Occupational:

# Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (nPEP) for Exposure to Blood or Body Fluids

# Treatment recommendations:

All persons offered nPEP should be prescribed a 28-day course of a 3-drug antiretroviral regimen.

* IMPORTANT- First dose should be given as soon as possible after exposure
* These medications may be taken with or without food
* Side effects of these medications are infrequent but may include:

nausea, vomiting, diarrha, rash, fever, headaches, insomnia, arthralgias, fatigue, abdominal pain, hepatitis, renal dysfunction, rare lactic acidosis

# Select appropriate treatment below based on renal function:
For non-pregnant individuals with creatinine clearance >/= 50 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q day ($$)[R,O] < AND > Dolutegravir 50MG Tab 1 po qday ($$)[O] for 28 days
For non-pregnant individuals with creatinine clearance 30-49 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q OTHER day ($$)[R,O] < AND > Dolutegravir 50MG Tab 1 po qday ($$)[O] for 28 days
For non-pregnant individuals with creatinine clearance 15-29 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q72hours ($$)[R,O] < AND > Dolutegravir 50MG Tab 1 po qday ($$)[O] for 28 days
For non-pregnant individuals with creatinine clearance <15 ml/min or dialysis:
Patient should receive all three drugs (Emtricitabine/Tenofovir/Dolutegravir)
Consult drug information for appropriate dosing for each individual drug based on renal function. Dispense supply for 28 days.

For pregnant females or females who may become pregnant while on PEP:
(Due to risk of neural tube defects associated with Dolutegravir at conception, Dolutegravir is not recommended to be used.)
For women of reproductive capacity who have had genital exposure to semen and a negative pregnancy test when evaluated for possible nPEP, current contraception use should be assessed, and if a risk for pregnancy exists, emergency contraception should be discussed with the patient.
For pregnant females with creatinine clearance >/= 50 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q day ($$)[R,O] < AND > Raltegravir 400MG po bid ($$) [O] for 28 days
For pregnant females with creatinine clearance 30-49 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q OTHER day ($$)[R,O] < AND > Raltegravir 400MG po bid ($$) [O] for 28 days
For pregnant females with creatinine clearance 15-29 ml/min:
Emtricitabine 200MG/Tenofovir 300MG Tab 1 po q72hours ($$)[R,O] < AND > Raltegravir 400MG po bid ($$) [O] for 28 days
For pregnant females with creatinine clearance <15 ml/min or dialysis:
Patient should receive all three drugs (Emtricitabine/Tenofovir/Raltegravir))
Consult drug information for appropriate dosing for each individual drug based on renal function. Dispense supply for 28 days.
